Eurorack modules from Germany

graeSynth – Eurorack modules

graeSynth is a Eurorack system of analogue, passive and digital modules that share one clearly labelled front panel design. The modules come assembled or as a kit to solder yourself.

In development · not yet available · images are renderings

The system

Three families, one design. The ID on every panel shows the family.

A

Analogue

The classic building blocks: oscillator, filter, VCA, envelope, LFO and everything that shapes voltages.

14 modules

P

Passive

Multiples, attenuators, mixers and switches. They need no power and no bus connection.

8 modules

D

Digital

Sequencers, randomness, MIDI, measurement and sound sources built around a microcontroller. The firmware can be updated.

13 modules

  • Eurorack format. 3U high, 4 to 12 HP wide, powered from ± 12 V through the standard bus connector.
  • Readable panels. Inputs and outputs are clearly separated, and outputs sit on gold fields. Lines show the signal path.
  • Assembled or as a kit. Assembled modules use SMD parts. The kits use through-hole parts and the same front panel.
  • Openly documented. Every module comes with user notes that give value ranges and patch ideas.

Development status

The circuits and circuit boards of all modules are designed and checked; prototypes have not been built yet. All figures on this site are calculated and may change before production. We will publish prices and delivery dates once the first prototypes have been measured.
